snippet.title: Parasol Superstars (Spica Adventure & Parasol Stars) | Digital Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Parasol Superstars is now available digitally for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4|5, and Xbox. This vibrant bundle brings together two iconic 2D platformers: Spica Adventure and Parasol Stars: The Story of Bubble Bobble III for players around the world.

For the first time ever, Spica Adventure makes its worldwide console debut, stepping out of its Japan-exclusive arcade and mobile origins. Paired with the beloved classic Parasol Stars, Parasol Superstars delivers a perfect blend of retro charm and fresh discovery.

SPICA ADVENTURE:
- Straight from the Arcades: Experience an arcade classic transported to consoles for the very first time!
- A Kaleidoscope of Colors: Feast your eyes on the uniquely cute and colorful 2D graphics.
- Parasol Action: Show off your extensive combat skills with the parasol!
- Through the Universe: Choose your own journey across the 28 colorful stages of Spica.
- Legendary Arcade-inspired Soundtrack: Vibe to the rhythm of ZUNTATA’s funky tunes!

AND...

PARASOL STARS:
- Addictive arcade-style gameplay
- Creative and clever game mechanics with magical Parasols
- More Parasols! Enjoy the tactical depth of the action-filled 2-Player Co-op
- A cosmic journey with 8 vibrant planets (and 2 secret bonus levels) 
- Catchy and memorable soundtrack

#ParasolSuperstars #SpicaAdventure #ParasolStars #RetroGaming #Arcade #NintendoSwitch #PlayStation #xbox

About ININ:
ININ Games is a leading publisher of high-quality retro and arcade video games, bringing classics from the ’80s, ’90s, and early 2000s to modern platforms – faithfully restored, reimagined, or continued with brand-new sequels. Dedicated to preserving digital gaming heritage, ININ enhances titles with technical improvements, new features, and quality-of-life options while retaining their original charm. Collaborations with Sega, Taito, Irem, Natsume, and Yu Suzuki have revived legendary series such as Space Invaders, Bubble Bobble, Shenmue, and Turrican. Active worldwide, ININ releases both physical and digital editions, and is rated by Metacritic as Germany’s highest-ranked publisher for exceptional quality and cultural value.
